text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code cleaner and easier to understand. This improves readability, so other programmers can quickly see how the program works. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes and poor designs pile up over time. By regularly cleaning up the code, teams keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain. However, it is important to remember that refactoring must not change the behavior of the software. The program should work exactly the same before and after.
